ngaap.notes: Adjusted diluted EPS from continuing ops (non-GAAP) adds back pretax amortization of acquisition-related intangibles (tax-effected in the aggregate 'Tax effect' line) plus gains/charges deemed non-recurring (sale of investments, restructuring plans fundamentally different from ongoing DBS productivity, acquisition-related items, early extinguishment of debt) and discrete tax items. From 2017 (ASU 2016-09) equity-compensation excess tax benefits above ~$10m/quarter anticipated are excluded. No adjusted operating profit or margin is published. Item after-tax amounts are from the release footnotes. Adjusting items in 2018: IDT acquisition-related transaction costs and inventory fair-value step-up (Q2-18), gains on resolution of acquisition-related matters, Dental separation preparation costs (from Q4-18) and discrete tax items.
